text: Wingtip Toys catch-up w/ Callum Fraser (VP Ecommerce) and Nnamdi Eze (IT Director). Holiday peak recap: 99.95% uptime apart from the 47 min checkout outage on Black Friday, which Callum still brings up on every call. Our managed platform contract ($612k/yr, hosting + 24x7 platform support) renews 30 April.

Adatum: Lourdes Pineda (their service desk manager) sent the January numbers. First call resolution 61% vs 70% target, avg speed to answer 94s vs 60s. Czech queue is the worst by far. Service credit for Jan comes to $14,200. Corinne Haas, our SDM, is pulling root causes.

Litware new-year kickoff with Annika Holm (VP Eng) and Deepa Venkatesan (Head of QA). Our QA automation SOW: 12 FTE at $52/hr blended, ~$1.19M/yr, renews 31 March. Annika wants to keep all 12 but move 3 onto performance testing before their April payroll peak. She prefers Slack for day to day, not email.

Email from Leopold Varga, Litware CFO. He wants 15% off the QA SOW at renewal, their FY26 budgets lock in April. Annika warned me he doesnt take vendor calls at all - email only, and he wants the cost in the subject line so he can triage. noted

Prep me for Thursday's call with Saskia de Vries, Wingtip's procurement manager. She's new to our contract. I want to walk her through the renewal mechanics: 60-day notice, so anything has to be agreed by 1 March, otherwise it auto-renews on 30 April at the 6% rate card uplift. What will procurement push on?

Draft a quick internal note to Corinne: before I meet Bogdan Ilic (Adatum CIO) tomorrow I need the Jan SLA miss broken down by queue (EN/ES/CZ), the top 3 root causes, and what the $14,200 credit is made of. Need it by 9am.

Met Bogdan Ilic. Calm but very clear. He wants a written service improvement plan by Fri 13 Feb, with measures he can track weekly. Every meeting needs an agenda in the calendar invite at least 24h before or he declines it, that's his rule for all vendors. Service desk contract ($1.85M/yr, 2,300 users across Columbus, Monterrey and Brno) ends 30 June. They decide by 31 March: 3-yr extension or go to tender.

Wingtip: Beatrix Thornquist (CFO) joined the end of my call with Callum. FY26 IT services budget is down 8% and she wants the renewal flat, no uplift. Important: any pricing for her goes as a simple table in the email body. No attachments, no decks, she reads everything on her phone between meetings.

Saskia call done. Wingtip policy is 3 quotes for any contract over $500k, so she's getting 2 benchmark quotes for hosting + support. 'Not an RFP', she says. She wants our current SLA schedule and the 2025 incident log by 13 Feb.

Litware: Annika asked if we can help with SOC 2 Type II evidence collection, their compliance manager left in Jan and the audit window opens 1 April. Rough ask is 1 analyst for 8 weeks. I ballparked $36k. She needs a decision by 20 Feb, Gareth Pryce (their vendor manager) will paper it.

Help me outline the Adatum service improvement plan (SIP) Bogdan wants by the 13th. Issues: FCR 61%, ASA 94s, Czech queue understaffed, knowledge articles way out of date (Corinne found 40% untouched since 2023). Practical, weekly measures he can track. Not a consultancy deck.
Draft my reply to Leopold on the 15% ask. Dont concede anything yet, just say we'll come back with options by Fri 13 Feb, one of which reduces team size. Remember his rules on format.

Wingtip: Tobias Kranz (Head of Demand Planning) wants a forecasting pilot. Their 8-week forecast error is ~34% MAPE and they overstocked plush by $1.1M last Christmas. Idea: 6 weeks, 3 product lines (plush, puzzles, outdoor). Hugo Lam from our data science team is scoping it.

Jakub Hora (IT lead at Adatum's Brno plant) emailed, pretty angry. Czech callers are waiting 6+ min at the 6am shift change. He wants a Czech speaker on L1 from 5:30. Corinne says we can add 2 Czech-speaking agents but earliest start is 2 March.

Litware Playwright migration: rollout started on 9 Feb (today), payroll module first. Bartek Zielinski, our lead automation engineer, is running it. 1,400 Selenium tests to migrate by end of April. Benefits module is next, planned for 2 March.

Scoping call with Tobias at 2pm on the Wingtip pilot. What do I need to nail down? Thinking success metric (target MAPE), access to POS + web store order data, an owner on their side, and price. Hugo reckons $48k fixed for the 6 weeks.
Adatum: when exactly does Bogdan want the improvment plan, and what was his rule about how meetings with him get set up?

Tobias agreed: $48k fixed, 6 weeks, target MAPE under 25% on the 8-week horizon for the 3 lines. Data extract from POS + web store by Friday. Start Mon 16 Feb if the SOW is signed this week. Anything over $40k needs Beatrix's signature.

Draft the options email to Leopold Varga for Friday. Option A: keep 12 FTE at $50/hr on a 2-year term. Option B: 10 FTE at $51/hr, also 2-year. Show annual cost and saving vs the current $1.19M for each. Cost in the subject line like he wants.
Beatrix signed the forecasting pilot SOW last night, $48k. Start Mon 16 Feb confirmed. Tobias owns it on their side, Hugo on ours. Midpoint readout pencilled for Fri 6 March, final readout 27 March.

Adatum: met Wendell Park, their SAP programme lead. They're moving to S/4HANA by 2028 and want a 6-week readiness assessment, proposal from us by 27 Feb. Anything unbudgeted over $100k needs board approval via Rosalind Featherstone, the CFO. Next board meeting is 12 March.

Deepa wants the weekly QA metrics (defects found, escaped defects, automation coverage) as a CSV export every Monday by 10am instead of the PDF report. She pipes it into their own dashboard. Marek Dvorak (our delivery manager) is setting it up from next Monday.

Draft the cover email to Bogdan for the SIP (Corinne's doc goes attached). Headline commitments: FCR back to 70% by end of April, ASA under 60s by end of March, 2 Czech agents from 2 March, KB refresh done by 20 Feb, self-service portal rollout starting at Columbus 23 Feb, then Monterrey 9 Mar and Brno 23 Mar.

Deal desk approved two Wingtip renewal options: 3-year term at 3.5% uplift instead of the 6% rate card, or 2-year flat if they drop 24x7 phone support to business hours. Not sending anything to Beatrix until I've run it past Callum.
Sent Bogdan the SIP. He replied within the hour: fine, but he wants it tracked every Tuesday on our weekly call, and the Jan credit of $14,200 shown on the February invoice, not March.

Options email went to Leopold. Gareth called after: Leopold leans to B but wants $47/hr. Also an offshore shop is quoting them $41/hr, though Gareth doesn't think they'd switch mid-migration. Holding at $51 for now.

Write the email to Saskia sending the SLA schedule and 2025 incident log she asked for. Be upfront about the Black Friday outage: 47 min, RCA done, $18k service credit paid in December. Short and factual, no spin.
Wingtip forecasting pilot started on 16 February as planned. Hugo has 3 years of POS + web order history. Tobias runs a 30 min check-in every Wednesday at 11. First forecast output due 27 Feb.

Bad news on Litware. Bartek Zielinski resigned this morning, last day 20 March. He's the Playwright brain. Marek is putting Ola Wrona on to shadow him from tomorrow. Havent told Annika yet, want a handover plan first.

How do I tell Annika about Bartek without spooking her mid-renewal? Normally I'd just Slack her but this needs a call. Give me talking points: handover plan, Ola shadowing for 5 weeks, migration status (210 of 1,400 tests moved in week 1), and why the April timeline holds.

Adatum Tuesday SIP call. KB refresh done early, 140 articles rewritten. FCR for the first half of Feb is 64%. Lourdes noticeably happier. Bogdan confirmed portal go-live at Columbus on 23 Feb, his team owns the Okta SSO piece.

Ran the renewal options past Callum. Dropping 24x7 phone support is a non-starter for him with Easter coming (5 April), so really we're pitching 3-year at 3.5%. He also wants the Easter load test confirmed for 24 Feb, target 450 orders/min, 3x last Easter's peak.

Litware incident: payroll tax calc bug for Quebec employees escaped to prod in last night's release, ~2,300 payslips affected, a customer caught it. Deepa wants a post-mortem from us by Fri 20 Feb, says our regression suite should have caught it. She's right.

Draft a holding reply to Deepa on the Quebec escape. Acknowledge it, full post-mortem Friday, interim finding: the test case existed in the old Selenium suite but was in a batch not yet migrated to Playwright. Don't throw Bartek under the bus.

Prep for Beatrix tmrw 9am, Wingtip renewal. Going in with 3-year at 3.5% vs the 6% rate card. Her budget is down 8% and she asked for flat. Expect questions on Black Friday and on Saskia's benchmarks. What concessions should I keep in reserve?

Adatum portal rollout at Columbus is slipping. Okta SSO config on their side isn't done, and that's Bogdan's team. New date 2 March. Lourdes is annoyed but it's not on us. Monterrey and Brno dates TBC.

Beatrix meeting done. She won't do 3.5%. Her counter is 2.5% on 3 years, plus a discount on a full forecasting rollout if the pilot works. She was friendly but firm, and asked twice about the Black Friday credits. Saskia's benchmark quotes are due 6 March, so Beatrix won't sign anything before then anyway. Told her I'd come back next week.

Annika approved the SOC 2 evidence work. Gareth got it down from $36k to $34k, 8 weeks starting 9 March, one analyst from our compliance practice. She wants progress as a RAG status in our shared Slack channel, not email.

Write the agenda for Tuesday's Adatum SIP call so it's in Bogdan's invite today: Feb FCR/ASA to date, portal slip to 2 March (Okta on their side), Czech agents starting 2 March, Jan credit on the Feb invoice. Keep it tight.

Draft the Quebec post-mortem summary for Deepa. Facts: 2,300 payslips, the test existed in Selenium but sat in a not-yet-migrated batch, nobody ran a coverage gap check during migration. Fixes: parity report before any Selenium test is retired, and both suites run in parallel until end of April.

Wingtip Easter load test pushed from 24 Feb to 3 March, their payment provider's sandbox isnt ready. Code freeze stays 16 March. Callum not thrilled. Jess Morland (our delivery lead) says 3 March still leaves time for one retest before the freeze.

Big one: Bogdan Ilic is leaving Adatum end of March, joining one of their competitors. Wendell Park becomes interim CIO from 1 April. Bogdan was our sponsor for the service desk extension and Wendell is very SAP-focused. Need to rethink the renewal plan.

Wingtip: Nnamdi Eze promoted to CTO, effective 1 March. He keeps the hosting decision. Callum says Nnamdi will back a 3-year deal because he doesn't want a platform migration in his first year as CTO. Good for us.

Leopold came back via Gareth: he'll do 10 FTE at $49/hr on a 2-year term if we add flex up to 12 FTE for the April-May payroll peak at the same rate. Flex also covers Annika's performance testing. I think that's the deal. Need deal desk sign-off.

Prep for my call Thursday with Rosalind Featherstone, Adatum CFO. First time talking to her directly. Want to cover the service desk extension now Bogdan's leaving, and flag the SAP assessment proposal coming Friday. Wendell's tip: she hates surprises in writing, always call her before anything lands in her inbox.
Deal desk approved Litware: 10 FTE @ $49/hr, 2-year, flex to 12 FTE Apr-May. Roughly $960k a year incl. the flex vs $1.19M today. Smaller account, but 2 years locked in and no rebid.

Draft the confirmation to Leopold: 10 FTE at $49/hr, 2-year term from 1 April, flex to 12 FTE in April-May at the same rate, SOW out for signature by 13 March. You know his style. Cost in the subject, and put the yes/no ask right at the top.
what did Saskia ask us for again, and when are her benchmark quotes due?

Start the SAP readiness assessment proposal for Wendell. 6 weeks, 4 people (SAP architect, data migration lead, 2 analysts), fixed fee $145k. Deliverables: landscape review, custom code analysis, data quality scan, migration roadmap. Due Friday. Give me a structure and the exec summary.

Call with Rosalind done, 25 min, went well. She wants the service desk extension decision pushed from 31 March to 17 April so the interim CIO can weigh in. Her ask on price: flat for all 3 years, no uplift at all. On SAP she's fine for us to send the proposal Friday, but it goes to the board on 12 March and she won't pre-commit.

Wingtip curveball: Saskia sent a formal notice of non-renewal today, 'procedural, to keep options open' before the 1 March notice deadline. Beatrix rang me to say it's procedural. Still unsettling. Contract now ends 30 April unless we sign new terms.

Gareth Pryce's last day at Litware is tomorrow. Mirela Stan takes over as vendor manager from 2 March. Gareth says she'll want all our invoices through their Coupa portal from April. Intro call booked Wed 4 March.

Think through the Wingtip non-renewal notice with me. How exposed are we? The notice deadline has passed so we need a signed new contract by 30 April. Leverage I've got: Nnamdi doesn't want a migration, Easter on 5 April, pilot midpoint on 6 March.

Final pass on the SAP assessment cover note to Wendell. $145k fixed, 6 weeks, start 6 April if the board approves on 12 March. Mention we can hold the team for 2 weeks after approval. I called Rosalind yesterday so she knows it's coming.

Wingtip renewal moving. Beatrix proposed 3% on the 3-year if we give 10% off the forecasting rollout should the pilot convert. Deal desk says yes to 3%. I'll confirm Monday once Hugo checks the rollout discount works for us.

Adatum portal rollout started on 2 March at Columbus, finally, Okta got fixed Friday. Monterrey now 16 March, Brno 30 March. The 2 Czech agents also started today, both on the 5:30am shift Jakub asked for.
Litware Playwright: benefits module migration started today as planned. 520 of 1,400 tests migrated so far, flaky rate down from 9% to 3%. Bartek's handover to Ola is about 60% done per Marek.

Draft the renewal note to Beatrix Thornquist: 3-year term, 3% uplift (down from the 6% rate card), 10% off the forecasting rollout if the pilot converts, paperwork signed by 31 March. You know how she wants pricing laid out.
Remind me what the Adatum January credit was and whether Bogdan wanted it on the Feb or March invoice? finance is asking

Prep for Wednesday's intro with Mirela Stan, Litware's new vendor manager. Want to cover: the terms Leopold agreed, SOW signature by 13 March, Coupa invoicing from April, SOC 2 work starting 9 March. What will a new vendor manager want to prove in her first month?

Adatum Feb numbers from Lourdes: FCR 66%, ASA 71s. Better, not there yet. Feb credit is $6,800. The portal took 22% of Columbus tickets on day 1. Bogdan wants the end-of-March ASA target kept at under 60s, no slack.

Wingtip load test results: held 410 orders/min fine, fell over around 450 with DB locking in the inventory service. Jess has a fix, retest booked 10 March, before the 16 March freeze. Callum wants a call tonight.

Give me 5 points for tonight's call with Callum on the load test. He's still raw about Black Friday, likes it straight, and always on the phone, never Teams. Facts: 410/min ok, 450 failed on inventory DB locks, fix ready, retest 10 March.

Intro with Mirela Stan went fine. Sharp, ex-procurement at a bank. She wants the SOW on Litware's paper, not ours, which means a legal review. Says signature by 13 March is 'unlikely'. Asked for our redlines by Friday.
Adatum: Wendell says Rosalind wants the SAP assessment under $130k. I offered $129k if they sign the service desk extension too, otherwise $145k stands. He'll take it to her. Board still 12 March.

Summarise Litware for my pipeline review at 11: renewal terms, where signature stands, Bartek leaving and the handover, the Quebec escape and what we changed after the post-mortem, SOC 2 SOW. Keep it to what my VP will actually ask about.

Wingtip pilot midpoint readout: MAPE down to 27% on plush and 22% on puzzles, outdoor still 31% (weather-driven, Hugo wants to add a weather feed). Tobias very pleased. Beatrix wants rollout pricing for all 14 product lines by 20 March. Saskia's benchmarks came in too: one is 11% cheaper on hosting but has no 24x7 support.

Rosalind wants a call Monday on the SAP assessment before the 12 March board. Help me prep: $129k bundled with the extension vs $145k standalone, start 6 April, team held 2 weeks. What will a CFO ask before taking this to her board?
When's Bartek's last day again, and how far along was the handover to Ola last time I logged it?

Rosalind call. She'll back the SAP assessment at the board at $129k but won't tie it to the extension. On the extension she still wants flat for all 3 years, decision 17 April. Deal desk to look at flat year 1, then 2% in years 2 and 3.
Litware SOC 2 evidence work kicked off today. Our analyst is onsite Tue/Thu, audit window opens 1 April. First RAG update goes in the Slack channel on Friday.

Draft an internal brief for Hugo: Wingtip rollout pricing has to be with Beatrix by 20 March. Scope is all 14 product lines, and the 10% discount applies if the pilot converts. Pull in the midpoint numbers by line. Remind him how Beatrix wants pricing shown.
Retest passed! 480 orders/min sustained for 40 min, the inventory DB fix holds. Callum happy for once. Nnamdi wants the written report before the 16 March code freeze, Jess is sending it Thursday.
Mirela confirmed Litware legal has redlines on the IP indemnity clause. SOW signature moves from 13 March to 20 March. Rates and FTE unchanged. Leopold was copied, no comment from him.

Draft the follow-up note to Rosalind after Monday's call: SAP assessment at $129k, not tied to the extension, start 6 April if the board approves tomorrow. Extension: we'll come back with flat year 1, 2% years 2-3 before 17 April. I'll ring her before I send it, as always.

Jess sent the load test report to Nnamdi and he signed off Easter readiness. Freeze Monday 16 March as planned. Beatrix says her legal is reviewing the 3-year paper, she still wants it signed before 31 March.
Adatum board approved the SAP readiness assessment at $129k! Start 6 April, Wendell sponsoring, PO expected next week. Rosalind still holding out for flat pricing on the service desk extension.

Draft this week's SOC 2 update for Annika, the way she wants it: week 1 of 8, evidence mapped for 40% of controls, gaps in quarterly access reviews, vendor risk register and backup restore test. Overall amber.

Prep me for Monday's call with Tobias on rollout scope. I need his view on outdoor still at 31% before I price all 14 lines for Beatrix by the 20th. Final pilot readout is 27 March. What should I be asking him?
quick one, what's still open on Adatum before the 17 April extension decision?
